S1.requires: Exact repeated occurrence, image target/identity and content-range bindings; public image_index exists.

S2.requires: Authored synthetic comments with dates, ranges, author, parent/resolved; T0 source comments absent.

S3.requires: Full ordered table cells/coordinates, horizontal/vertical spans, nested and multiple tables.

S4.requires: Distinct fn/en same-ID references, literal markers, table references and cached NOTEREF association.

S5.requires: PPTX harbor/quay slide order/hidden/source-part/shape/comment evidence; never an observed DOCX claim.

S6.requires: Full source inventory including revisions/comments/empty/orphan stories, warning classes and silent optional-read loss; malformed acceptance/resource boundaries measured separately.

S7.requires: Full prefix-independent body/stories/cells/figures; no source omission expected.

measurement_protocol: All listed observations came from real O1 runs. Full expected/actual values and failing originals remain in retained logs and measured-observations.json; canonical hashes permanently assert source expectations and actual evidence. Typed assertions separately cover revisions, comments, note collisions/table references, spans/nesting, orphan/header order, prefix body loss, images and resource causes. EvidenceOnly is never whole fidelity proof. Unknown/unregistered observations fail after this measured pin.
promotion: BLOCKED until all independent source/evidence/resource/host/nested-attachment/retirement gates close; passing observation capture alone is insufficient.
limits: Pre-admission E/P and E+P iterations are candidates, not a hard heap/DOM/allocation proof. No production Office route is changed. Existing SDK/widget/PDF/platform/native-human/live qualifications remain carried.

resource_gates.DTD: BLOCKED: real Xberg accepts unused internal DTD; the original refusal assertion remains failing. Current helper refuses. No production fix or quota change.
resource_gates.events: Current 200000-event refusal versus accepted Xberg 200001-run case; same admission not proved.
resource_gates.iterations: E+P header case refuses at 7302 with cap 7301. Fixed Boundary case threshold 24/23. No automatic quota raising.
resource_gates.consistency: Current accepts all six central-size lies; Xberg required undersize refuses and optional-note undersize silently drops note without warning. Both directions still require pre-admission consistency.
